properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: the size, cost and architect credits in the notes came from an Architizer listing that returned 403 and were not in the geometry file's other cited sources (OSM; UCSF history; the 403 UCSF 2011-05 release); the notes now say so and record the conflicting contractor figures. Sources added to source_doc_urls.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 (675 Mission Bay Blvd in the repo's DataSF parcels copy) alone is about 12.2 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: Five stories; size and cost conflict between sources: an Architizer listing credited to SmithGroup (not readable in the 2026-09 audit) gives ~236,000 sq ft and ~$254 million, while two contractor pages (Tutor Perini; Rudolph and Sletten) give 323,000 sq ft and a $196 million contract amount. Headquarters of the UCSF Cardiovascular Research Institute (UCSF history: opening in 2010) with laboratories, an outpatient clinic and a vivarium. Architect per Architizer SmithGroup with Jim Jennings Architecture (landscape Andrea Cochran Landscape Architecture); the contractor pages say SmithGroupJJR. Opened 2010 (year only; a specific Nov 1, 2010 date found in one search summary was not traceable to a primary document, so not used).
